name: Proposal for a decision not to waive immunity in point I
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Diana Iovanovici Şoşoacă
part_text:
Romanian prosecutors want to put Diana Iovanovici Şoşoacă, a Romanian member of the European Parliament, on trial for several alleged offences. Parliament has to decide whether to lift her legal protection. This report proposes lifting it for seven of the eight allegations, including a 2021 false imprisonment claim and several statements about Jewish people and war criminals. It proposes keeping her protection for one speech she made inside the European Parliament itself, because that counts as a political opinion expressed in her duties.

- Parliament would let Romanian prosecutors pursue seven allegations, but not her European Parliament speech.
- It affects Diana Iovanovici Şoşoacă and the Romanian prosecutors handling her case.
- Parliament votes on this proposal; if passed, Romania is told and can proceed.
